results.title: The future of risk and insurability in the era of systemic disruption ...
results.content: By cultivating organizational shock absorbers and dynamic responsiveness, the AAA framework enables stakeholders to navigate open-ended volatility, build adaptive capability for decision-making under deep uncertainty and seize emergent opportunities across multiple plausible futures. These systemic disruptions – whether ecological, technological, geopolitical or economic – may vary in severity, but all demand a reevaluation of the assumptions underlying our current risk models and strategic paradigms (Spitz 2025b). This paper examines the conceptual distinctions between risk and deep uncertainty, exploring their implications for insurability, decision-making and risk governance in the twenty-first century, while proposing the antifragile, anticipatory and agility (AAA) framework to address unpredictability and systemic disruption within risk and insurance domains (Spitz 2020). In today’s landscape – defined by systemic disruption, profound unpredictability and the accelerating influence of AI – the future of risk and insurability is confronting unprecedented challenges. Evaluating risk, uncertainty and data is necessary to develop antifragility, as the focus shifts from probabilities to potential outcomes.

results.title: How Can Futurists Shape a Future Already Colliding with the Present?
results.content: As our understanding deepens, our focus must shift to engendering agency - developing superpowers for sense-making, decision-making, and intuiting the consequences of our choices, all in service of building aspirational futures within real-world constraints.” —------------- These are excerpts from my latest article in 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐀𝐏𝐅𝐱𝐃𝐅𝐅 𝐒𝐩𝐞𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐬𝐬 𝐄𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 which is now available: “𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐌𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐬 𝐚 𝐅𝐮𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭?” I’m honored to have contributed some thoughts to the special edition of Compass, APF's flagship publication, edited by Stephen Dupont, MSc, APR, Fellow PRSA, and Patrick Noack. How Can Futurists Shape a Future Already Colliding with the Present?” —------------- Special thanks to the teams at APF and GFS that curated this special issue, including: Stephen Dupont, MSc, APR, Fellow PRSA, Patrick Noack, Eman Ebed Alkadi, Maryam Yousuf, and Issam Yasin. My issue isn’t with futurists; it’s with how easily the title can be adopted without the mastery of sense-making, pattern intelligence, and decision stewardship needed in a world where the future is no longer “ahead” but colliding with the present in real time.
